row:
Dr. C is a pediatric physical therapist with 20 years experience.  

This station is focused on pediatric physical therapy intervention ideas for the purpose of guiding home programming as well as a resource for pediatric teletherapy services by a physical therapist.  Occupational therapist may also find these videos helpful as an adjunct to their programming. 

All pediatric physical therapy services should be overseen by a licensed physical therapist with an active doctor's prescription, depending on your state. These videos are not designed to replace direct therapy or teletherapy services, nor are they meant to substitute professional medical advice, diagnosis or intervention.  Please speak to your pediatrician or therapist before beginning any virtual programming. All activities must be adult supervised and done at your own risk.   

Hopefully these videos will be a great resource for pediatric therapists and the children and families they service.  Please enjoy! :-) Dr. C
